lead_raw_text:
The trigonal structure of MgMn2(FeO3)2 (space group R-3, No. 148) has 27 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Fe and Mg each adopt octahedral oxygen environments, while Mn centers have six oxygen neighbors. Oxygen environments include two-, three-, and four-coordinate sites, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Fe and Mg octahedra, and between Fe octahedra and 12-vertex oxygen coordination polyhedra.
